headline: 🔥 THE TOP-OF-LIST AGENT IS NOW THREE DAYS UNCALLED — Amy G. filed Saturday night: interested YES, both price fields blank, and in her own words her buyers "really like the property and have put it at the top of their list." Nothing new has come in since; this only got older. ⚠️ AND THE FORWARD CALENDAR IS EMPTY — not one showing booked on eight active listings across a full weekend, which is itself the second story on this board.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 AMY G. OF ETHOS INTERNATIONAL FILED SATURDAY AT 11:24 PM off that afternoon's 1:00 PM tour: interested — YES, staged 3, and in her own words — "My buyers have just started looking. They really like the property and have put it at the top of their list." ⭐ SHE LEFT BOTH PRICE FIELDS BLANK, which makes this the FIFTH consecutive read since the 8/5 cut where nobody argued the number. ⭐ And she is the same agent who phoned from inside the house mid-showing — the channel is already open and warm. ⏰ THIS IS DAY THREE AND NOTHING HAS CHANGED EXCEPT THE AGE. Two full ShowingTime sweeps since have returned nothing new on any listing, so this is still the single best signal on the board and still the oldest unworked one.
hotSignals.action: Call her this morning, don't email — you have a live thread with her already. Three things: answer the basement lights concretely (still open from her call), ask what moves her buyers from top-of-list to an offer — timing, possession, closing costs — and ask what she'd change on staging, since she scored a 3 and is the only agent to score staging since the cut. ⚠️ Reported honestly: this is the second consecutive pass with no receipt that the call happened. A call from the truck leaves no trace, so this is 'no evidence', not 'not called' — but a third empty pass gets escalated.

📭 NO SHOWINGS BOOKED — AND A FULL WEEKEND PASSED WITHOUT A SINGLE NEW REQUEST. There is not one future showing, walk-through, inspection or appraisal confirmed on any of your listings. The last tour on the calendar was Saturday 4:00 PM at Ridge Trail, and the newest ShowingTime notice of any kind remains Saturday night's Comanche feedback — nothing has arrived in over 27 hours. ⭐ Said plainly because an empty row reads like a data problem and this is not one: the notices were pulled again this morning and the forward calendar is genuinely clear. ⚠️ Three days with no new booking across eight active listings is itself the finding — the week ahead currently has nothing in it.

listings.note: ⏰ THE DECISION IS TODAY. Four independent sources read 08-17 — the CRM crawl, the operations-manager reminder due today, the chip that first caught the conflict, and this morning's marketing brief. This board printed 8/14 twice and was wrong both times; the correction is logged rather than quietly swapped. ⚠️ And it is a REINSTATEMENT, not an extension, per Don's own Saturday reply — in which he also confirmed Mrs Ann had not yet been asked. 🔴 NO LANE HAS EVER SIGHTED THE SIGNED DOCUMENT — eighth consecutive pass, and one lane still reads it as having expired last Friday. That conflict is printed rather than hidden, because reinstatement and extension are different instruments and the call is today. 🆕 THE CASE FOR HOLDING THE PRICE GOT THINNER SUNDAY: Robert C., the unrepresented buyer who phoned Thursday about the workshop and garage, STOOD DOWN at 1:27 PM — his wife wants to hold off — and Gene answered him at 4:57. He was the single strongest live argument for reinstating flat, and his chip was closed with a written reason rather than left to age. ⭐ Day 92, no price change since May, one written offer all summer, and Friday's tour produced total silence. ⭐ Both feedback forms this house has ever produced left every price field blank — the objections were the upstairs bathroom and a compartmentalized interior. Nobody who has walked it has ever named a different number. ⚠️ Quote $450,000 only until the sellers rule.

listings.note: ✅ CORRECTION WORTH READING: the inspection-response letter was NOT sitting unsent — Gene sent it himself Saturday 9:54 AM. The document still in drafts is a DUPLICATE created six minutes later and is flagged for DELETION, not aged as pending follow-up. Two separate reads called it 'unsent for 24 hours'; both were reading the copy. ⚠️ It is now roughly two days old and still nothing has deleted it — the oldest hazard in the drafts folder. ⭐ THE SHAPE OF THE ASK IS THE STORY: they inspected seventy-one items, flagged sixty-eight at some level, and asked for exactly three. That is a reasonable buyer. ⭐ The response sent was two yeses and a hold — agree to the basement leak and a scoped HVAC service; on the roof, don't say no, say give us a few days and our own licensed roofer's report. The inspector wrote in the same section that he cannot determine the roof's age or remaining life. ⚠️ FHA, so the appraiser can raise the roof independently, and the concession room under the FHA cap is small — this gets solved with work, not a check. ✅ Sellers have acknowledged the roof-holdback approach. 🔴 The date the buyers' repair-resolution window actually closes does not exist anywhere in this system — a real gap, and it is live on this file today. ⭐ Closing 10/23.

✅ STILL THE CLEANEST FILE ON THE BOARD ON PAPER — inspection ran 8/5 at noon, appraisal 8/7 at 9:00 AM, both on primary ShowingTime notices, and the closing invite matches stored state. AN INSPECTION AND AN APPRAISAL BOTH SPENT IS THE STRONGEST POSITION ANY DEAL HERE OCCUPIES. ✅ THE ONE ITEM THAT COULD HAVE BITTEN IT GOT CAUGHT WITHOUT YOU — your operations manager chased and closed the payoff on 8/14 with two status comments on the record. That is the catch that protects the 8/28 close, and it is worth telling her so. 🔴 AND YET THE SELLER HAS BEEN WAITING ON A RETURNED CALL SINCE LAST TUESDAY — six days, mid-transaction, on the deal with the least to worry about. Today is Client Day. ⚠️ The appraised value still has not come back at day eleven. ⚠️ The buyer's agent asked for a specific co-op commission and nobody has ever answered — real money on an otherwise settled deal.

The reversal was printed rather than quietly dropped. ✅ Everything else already went right: both sellers executed all seven documents Friday morning (11:41 and 11:49) on three separate receipts, and the milestone engine fired this address for the first time in its life. 🔴 STILL OPEN AND LANDING TODAY: the MLS input prep behind the shoot — the step between a photo shoot and a live listing. 🔴 AND THE BUY SIDE, ON THE DAY IT WAS PROMISED: she came in unprompted saying they were very interested in a property AND about ready to list their own. This is the LIST half of a two-sided deal; the BUY half has never been worked, no criteria or budget is recorded anywhere, and Gene's own text said 'want to look Monday?' ⚠️ The $185,000 price is Gene's own ruling and quotable, but still has no primary MLS source.

Eight names off this one ad now, while every other ad in the portfolio produced zero. ✅ THE DELIVERABLE WAS LOCATED FRIDAY — the 19-lot plat, exactly what the open buyer chip had been waiting on since he answered "Yes". 🔴 THE THING THAT SHOULD BOTHER YOU IS THE HANDOFF, NOT THE COUNTY, AND IT IS DAY FIVE: the builder asked the septic perc question on 8/12, your operations manager researched and answered it completely, and that answer has sat on her board since Friday with nobody reading it back to him. The work was done, the delivery never happened. ⭐ THE PERC QUESTION IS PRICED, NOT BLOCKED: county records are in-person only, weekdays 8:00–3:30, per-record fee — nineteen lots is a four-figure errand. So the choice is three-way: pull all nineteen, narrow to the lots a buyer asks about, or ask the developer first, who almost certainly holds the perc results from platting. PERC DECIDES BUILDABILITY AND BUILDABILITY DECIDES PRICE PER LOT. ⚠️ Two builder outreach addresses hard-bounced permanently — part of the builder audience received nothing at all.

oweFeedback.when: 🔴 THREE ASKS AND TWENTY-SEVEN DAYS OF SILENCE — 7/21, 7/22 and 7/23, from the RealtySouth Inverness listing side after your 7/21 1:00 PM tour. ⭐ THIS IS THE ONE THAT COSTS SOMETHING REAL, and the cost is not the courtesy — it is that the honest written answer IS your counter on the largest number on your board, roughly $36K of GCI. The listing side has asked repeatedly to be moved forward; a seller who reverse-offers a buyer is a seller who wants a deal. Twenty minutes of writing moves it. ⚠️ The appraisal figure your buyer cited as far under ask is single-sourced from him — do not quote it to the other side as an appraised value.
